targets.raw_notes: Reloadly is the industry's cleanest example of PUBLISHED differential API pricing: wholesale = face value minus per-brand discountPercentage (gift cards, sample 2-7.5%) minus per-operator commission (airtime, sample up to 10% international), plus sender fees + FX spread. cross_benchmark_summary.comparison_to_prior_mec5_findings: ProdSeller (public API+bulk tiers, avg API gap 12.0%) and StackVault (avg gap 19.9%) remain the only confirmed PUBLIC-vs-API dual-price suppliers so far. Among industry benchmarks, only Reloadly publishes wholesale discounts openly (2-10% doc samples); DingConnect hides them behind free login; Bitrefill replaces discounts with revenue share.
actionable_next_steps: Open free Reloadly account -> GET /discounts live pull = full per-brand wholesale table (2-10%+ range expected) for P3 benchmarking
Open free DingConnect account -> 'Products & Pricing' page = live per-operator wholesale rates (currently unmeasured)
U7BUY: apply for Seller API (needs account + reason + email verify) only if supply-side automation is strategically useful - it is NOT a cheaper buying channel
Z2U: no API route; treat as C2C retail market only (cost = seller price + 0 buyer-side platform discount; platform takes 5-9% from seller)
